messages:
Elena: Morning team — finished the security course but my phish sim link shows 'verification failed: device_unknown'. Any idea?
Kim (People Ops): Hey Elena, welcome! Did you do the training on personal laptop or company device?
Elena: Company laptop (MacBook Air M2). I clicked the sim link from the Okta email and it bounced back to an error page.
Diego (IT): Can you run `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` and `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial` and paste outputs?
Elena: enrollment: Not Enrolled
Serial Number (system): C02Z4L55555
Elena: Also I didn't get a FileVault prompt earlier.
Diego (IT): Sounds like MDM didn't finish. Without MDM the IdP blocks device attestation and our phish sim provider marks the click as device_unknown. I'll check provisioning.
OnboardBot: Device RD-4781 assigned to C02Z4L55555 at 1971234590 by Diego
Marta (Security): If needed we can do a one-off verification of the training (screenshot + timestamp) but we prefer a re-run post-enrollment to keep telemetry consistent.
Elena: Ok — posted screenshot in the HR ticket. How long does MDM re-enroll take?
Diego (IT): Usually a few minutes once I re-trigger imaging. I'll push CompanyProfile and then you'll get a prompt in System Settings to approve device management. Don't enable FileVault until I confirm escrow.
Kim (People Ops): We'll mark the LMS status pending so it doesn't block access.
Diego (IT): Pushed at 1971234650. Approve the profile and run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment`, reply when it shows enrolled.
Elena: Approved. Command now returns: enrollment: Enrolled (CompanyProfile v2)
OnboardBot: PhishSim: auto-tag -> pending_rerun for user Elena at 1971234702
Marta (Security): Great. I'll unlock the IdP attestation and schedule the sim re-send tomorrow to avoid noisy alerts. If the re-run still fails we'll follow the remediation playbook.
Elena: Thanks all 64f  — first-day jitters sorted!
